verdict.rationale: Kintsugi's API supports creating exemption records with type, jurisdiction, and validity dates (docs-14, docs-24), implying some storage and expiry-date tracking, but there is no evidence of a customer-facing collection/validation workflow or documentation confirming exemptions are automatically applied at tax-calculation time. missing for 10: customer certificate collection/upload flow, validation logic, expiry alerting, and explicit linkage to the tax calculation endpoint honoring exemptions.
